Your Journey

How It Works

A clear, proven 4-step process to get you from Bangladesh to Japan — with support at every stage.

01

Learn Japanese

Master JLPT N5–N2 with our expert instructors. Build strong foundations in reading, writing, listening, and speaking.

02

Pass JLPT / JFT Exam

Get certified with intensive exam preparation, mock tests, and proven strategies that ensure first-attempt success.

03

Apply for COE

We handle your Certificate of Eligibility application, document preparation, and liaising with Japanese immigration.

04

Fly to Japan ✈️

Start your new career in Japan! We provide pre-departure orientation and ongoing support even after you arrive.

Why Choose Us

Your Trusted Partner for a Career in Japan

Achieve Japan has been Bangladesh's leading Japanese language training and overseas job consultancy for over 17 years. We don't just teach — we build futures.

Our comprehensive approach covers everything from language mastery and skill certification to visa processing and job placement in Japan. With direct partnerships across Japanese companies and educational institutions, we provide a seamless pathway to your Japanese dream.
